_note: Hand-curated modding builds, richer than the Taiwan sheet's one-line combo string: each carries a mod-strength grade (community T-scale, where T0 is the ceiling), a handling difficulty and playing notes. Joined onto a blade in loadCatalogue() by `blade`, which is matched against both the blade's product id (e.g. UX-14) and its base Chinese name key (e.g. 武士魂斬), so it attaches to every colour variant of a mold. Rendered as a 'Custom builds' block in PartSheet, with each part shown as a chip that resolves to its own catalogue entry.

builds.title: Precision Orbit · 精致回旋
notes: A precision orbit build — it lives on tight, controlled circling.
Wins on read and handling; built mainly to counter the Shark ball-bit setups.
Takes a lot of practice to pilot well.
Evade first, then commit to the clash.
Needs advanced launch and handling technique.
It can't cut across the clock — it won't break out of the banked circling path.
Best launched above 13,000 SP. It doesn't revive, so the margin for error is low.
Against stamina types, go straight in and brawl.

builds.title: Precision Orbit, scaled up · 精致回旋放大版
notes: The scaled-up take on the precision orbit build: heavier, and friendlier to newcomers.
The handling difficulty isn't as high as the 武士魂斬 version.
